name: Alchemists

categories.label: Reputation points
categories.hint: All reputation on the scoring track becomes victory points.

categories.label: Artifact victory points
categories.hint: Sum of VP on your artifacts (some variable, see card). Count Magic Mirror first; Wisdom Idol after the Big Revelation.

categories.label: Grant victory points
categories.hint: Each grant tile is worth 1 or 2 VP.

categories.label: Gold and favor cards to VP
categories.labelVi: Vàng và thẻ favor đổi điểm
categories.hint: 1 VP per 3 gold; each unused favor card counts as 2 gold. Hand ingredients are worth nothing.

categories.label: Theory seals after the Big Revelation
categories.hint: Correct gold seal +5, correct silver seal +3, unstarred correct 0. Wrong starred seal -4; wrong unstarred seal -4 unless properly hedged.

categories.label: Leftover gold (tiebreaker)
categories.hint: Gold remaining after buying VP at 3 gold each (favor cards counted as 2 gold).

tiebreakers.description: Most leftover gold pieces after converting gold to VP
If still tied, players remain tied.

notes: family: deduction. Master and apprentice variants share the same final scoring. Reputation bonuses/penalties and the red/green/blue track zones do not apply during final scoring. Properly hedged = unstarred seal hedged against the single wrong aspect; if more than one aspect is wrong no seal is hedged. Expansion Alchemists: King's Golem not modelled. Rule text from RulesPal transcription of the CGE rulebook; original PDF link was unavailable.
